blocks.text: Build full-stack web applications without writing code

Bubble is the most capable no-code application builder available, enabling the creation of full-stack web applications that would traditionally require a development team. User authentication, database design, API integrations, and complex business logic - all built visually.

The platform handles genuine application complexity. Build marketplace platforms, SaaS products, CRM systems, and project management tools - not just landing pages. Bubble applications can have user roles, payment processing, real-time data, and third-party API integrations, all configured through visual editors.

For startups validating product ideas, Bubble offers a compelling path: build a functional MVP in weeks instead of months, validate with real users, and iterate based on feedback - all before committing to a custom-coded solution. Many successful startups launched their first version on Bubble before rebuilding with code at scale.
Full-stack development with drag-and-drop UI and visual logic
Built-in relational database with custom types and privacy rules
Sign-up, login, roles, and permissions out of the box
Connect to any REST API for third-party integrations
Event-driven logic for handling user actions and background processes
Build interfaces that adapt to desktop, tablet, and mobile

When clients need a functional web application without a development team, Bubble is our first recommendation. It handles real application complexity - not just simple CRUD - making it possible to validate ambitious product ideas quickly.
Our team can integrate Bubble into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
